steps.title: ENTER THE CORE
steps.text: Camera tour. Click SKIP, press Enter / Space, or gamepad A to start.

steps.title: TRAINING 1 / MOVE
steps.text:
Walk to the gold marker.
{MOVE}, left stick, or touch joystick.

steps.title: TRAINING 2 / COUNT TO {LUCKY}
steps.text:
Your number is {VALUE}. Lucky Number is {LUCKY}: you need {NEED}.
Grab the marked orb and keep counting until you hit {LUCKY}.

steps.title: LUCKY {LUCKY}! YOU COUNTED IT
steps.text:
Hitting the Lucky Number fires your laser at OMEGA-99.
Your number resets to 1. Count again!

steps.title: TRAINING 3 / FIRE
steps.text:
Fire three shots: {FIRE}, hold mouse, RT, or FIRE.
Shooting a + orb turns it into - (and back).

steps.title: TRAINING 4 / DASH
steps.text:
Dash: {DASH}, gamepad A, or DASH.
Dash flips YOUR sign: +3 becomes -3.

steps.title: TRAINING 5 / DODGE
steps.text:
Weave through the gaps for 12 seconds.
Practice hits are free. The live round is next.
